#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

dir="log_files"
now=$(date +%s)
cutoff=$((now - 7*24*60*60))
sum=0

is_prime() {
  local n=$1 i
  (( n >= 2 )) || return 1
  for ((i=2; i*i<=n; i++)); do
    (( n % i )) || return 1
  done
  return 0
}

shopt -s nullglob
for file in "$dir"/log_server_*_????-??-??.txt; do
  base=${file##*/}
  sid=${base#log_server_}
  sid=${sid%%_*}
  [[ $sid =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || continue
  is_prime "$sid" || continue

  birth=$(stat -c %W -- "$file" 2>/dev/null || echo -1)
  if (( birth > 0 )); then
    ts=$birth
  else
    ts=$(stat -c %Y -- "$file")
  fi
  (( ts >= cutoff )) || continue

  while IFS= read -r line; do
    [[ $line =~ ^-?[0-9]+$ ]] && (( sum += line ))
  done < "$file"
done

printf '%s\n' "$sum"
EOF
chmod +x sum_prime_recent_logs.sh"}
